records.source_statement: Third-house ruler helping mediation is interpreted as help by a brother.
limitations: Original family-role mapping, not independently identified.

records.source_statement: Tenth-house lord in the mediation list represents mother.
limitations: Keep local context; later house-obstacle list differs.

records.source_statement: Fifth- or eleventh-house lord mediating is associated with friend.
Sixth-house mediation may represent uncle, aunt or servant.
Marriage indicated by conjunction, square or opposition is described as laborious; trine/sextile easier, reception best.
limitations: Not a yes without other conditions.

records.source_statement: Separate heading asks what will hinder the marriage and starts an interception/frustration procedure.
A planet intercepting reception, transferring light or frustrating intended aspects is used to attribute an obstruction through its house.
limitations: Depends on relevant significators' intended contact.
